originalTitle: ITC Hotels Q1 net up 36% at Rs 181.91 crore
simplifiedContent: ITC Hotels just reported that they made 36% more profit in the first quarter of the year, with a total of Rs 181.91 crore. This is good news for the company, as their revenue from operations also increased from last year. The company is also expanding its business by buying GHK Hospitality & Infrastructures Ltd, which will add more hotels to their portfolio in Ahmedabad. This move, along with strong growth in their hotel and branded residences businesses, is a positive sign for the company's future. Overall, ITC Hotels is doing well and is taking steps to grow its business even more.

originalTitle: US Stock Market: Healthy loan growth and stable credit trends boost outlook for US bank stocks
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening: big banks in the US are saying that people are still spending a lot of money and taking out loans, which is a good sign for the banks. This is because many people have stable jobs and are earning more money, which helps them pay back their loans. As a result, the outlook for bank stocks is looking better. This matters because it could be a good time to invest in bank stocks, but there are still some risks to consider, such as higher borrowing costs and inflation. Overall, it seems like people's finances are in good shape, which is helping the banks and potentially making their stocks more attractive.

originalTitle: SWREL Q1 profit grows 38% to over Rs 53 crore
simplifiedContent: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy, a company that works with renewable energy, made a profit of over Rs 53 crore in the first quarter of the year, which is 38% more than the same time last year. This increase in profit happened because the company was able to reduce its expenses. Even though the company's total income went down, it still had a lot of orders from customers that it hasn't started working on yet, which is the highest it's ever been. This is a good sign for the company's future growth. The high number of orders suggests that customers have confidence in the company, which could lead to more growth in the future.

originalTitle: Retail investors return with vengeance in Q1 but start selling again in July
simplifiedContent: Individual investors, like you, put a lot of money into the stock market in the first three months of the year, buying stocks worth about ₹39,287 crore. This was the most they've invested in a quarter since the end of 2024, when they bought stocks worth ₹42,746 crore. However, it seems they've changed their minds and started selling their stocks again in July. This is important because when individual investors buy or sell stocks, it can affect the overall stock market. The fact that they invested heavily earlier in the year, but are now selling, could be a sign of changing market trends.

originalTitle: BHEL Q1 results: BHEL swings to  ₹376.71 crore net profit in June quarter
simplifiedContent: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) just released its financial results for the first quarter of the year, which ended in June. The company made a profit of ₹376.71 crore, which means it earned more money than it spent. This is a positive change for BHEL, as it was not profitable in the same quarter last year. The increase in profit is due to the company earning more income than before. This news matters because it can affect the price of BHEL's stock and influence investors' decisions to buy or sell the company's shares.

originalTitle: Metal stock Shyam Metalics hits a record high after this business update. Details here
simplifiedContent: The stock price of a company called Shyam Metalics has reached its highest point ever. This happened after the company shared some business updates, although the details of these updates are not specified. The stock has been doing well overall, with its price increasing by 23% since the start of the year and by 9% just in the month of July. This means that people who own shares of Shyam Metalics have seen the value of their investment rise significantly. The recent increase in the stock's price may be a sign that investors are feeling positive about the company's future prospects.
